menuDescription: Driving model selection and model-related settings

controls.title: Current Model
controls.desc: The driving model currently in use

controls.title: Select Driving Model
controls.desc: Choose a different driving model. Model selection requires the device UI for the tree selection dialog.
controls.device_only_message: Model selection must be done on the device UI. This feature requires the interactive model browser.

controls.title: Refresh Model List
controls.desc: Fetch the latest available models from the server
controls.device_only_message: Model refresh must be done on the device UI.

controls.title: Clear Model Cache
controls.desc: Delete all downloaded models except the currently active model
controls.confirm_text:
This will delete ALL downloaded models from the cache except the currently active model.

Are you sure you want to continue?
controls.device_only_message: Cache clearing must be done on the device UI.

controls.title: Use Lane Turn Desires
controls.desc: If you're driving at 20 mph (32 km/h) or below and have your blinker on, the car will plan a turn in that direction at the nearest drivable path. This prevents situations (like at red lights) where the car might plan the wrong turn direction.

controls.title: Lane Turn Speed Threshold
controls.desc: Set the maximum speed for lane turn desires. Default is 19 mph (32 km/h).

controls.title: Live Learning Steer Delay
controls.desc: Enable this for the car to learn and adapt its steering response time. Disable to use a fixed steering response time. Keeping this on provides the stock openpilot experience.

controls.title: Software Delay
controls.desc: Adjust the software delay when Live Learning Steer Delay is toggled off. The default software delay value is 0.20 seconds.

controls.title: Reset Model Calibration
controls.desc: Reset calibration parameters. Recommended when switching to a different model generation.
controls.confirm_text:
This will reset all calibration and learning parameters:

- Calibration Parameters
- Live Torque Parameters
- Live Parameters
- Live Delay

The system will need to recalibrate. Are you sure?
